data.narrative: Completed Module 7 learning postmortem quality - chose narrow scope for deep analysis of auth bypass incident, wrote blameless postmortem with 8 sections (summary, timeline with precise UTC timestamps, root cause as systemic, 5 contributing factors using systems as subjects, specific impact numbers, resolution details, 5 actionable remediation items with WHAT/WHO/WHEN, lessons learned including where we got lucky). Critiqued and rewrote bad postmortem to transform blame language into systems language.

dimension_scores.observation: Module 7 did not directly exercise hypothesis quality - focused on postmortem writing. Set baseline score as no evidence yet.
dimension_scores.evidence: No hypothesis formation performed in Module 7 - focused on postmortem analysis and writing.

dimension_scores.observation: Timeline construction required pulling precise timestamps from logs and monitoring data. Used log data to reconstruct incident timeline with UTC timestamps.
dimension_scores.evidence: module7_auth_bypass_postmortem.md timeline uses precise UTC timestamps (14:22 UTC, 14:27 UTC, etc.) derived from log data

dimension_scores.observation: Module 7 did not directly exercise reproduction skill - focused on postmortem writing after incident was resolved. Set baseline score as no evidence yet.
dimension_scores.evidence: No reproduction tasks performed in Module 7 - focused on postmortem analysis of previously resolved incident.

dimension_scores.observation: Postmortem writing is a form of structured communication to stakeholders. Documented incident clearly for leadership and team consumption. Honesty under pressure demonstrated in acknowledging what went poorly and where we got lucky.
dimension_scores.evidence: module7_auth_bypass_postmortem.md includes clear communication of impact, resolution, and lessons learned for stakeholders

dimension_scores.observation: Identified 5 systemic contributing factors (no integration tests, no SAST, no rate limiting, no anomaly detection, no security checklist) - all systems not people. Root cause traced to auth middleware design relying on single conditional without explicit validation.
dimension_scores.evidence: module7_auth_bypass_postmortem.md contributing factors all use systems as subjects (test suite, CI pipeline, API gateway, monitoring, code review process)

dimension_scores.observation: Wrote blameless postmortem with no individuals named or blamed. All 5 contributing factors use systems as subjects. All 5 remediation items are actionable with specific WHAT/WHO/WHEN. Successfully critiqued bad postmortem example identifying blame language and transformed it into systems language. Timeline uses precise timestamps.
dimension_scores.evidence: module7_auth_bypass_postmortem.md is blameless. module7_bad_postmortem_analysis.md critiques blame language. module7_postmortem_rewrite.md demonstrates transformation to systems language.
